types.description: Motor circuit breaker / TeSys GV2 (Deca) / 3-pole / thermal-magnetic 20-25 A / 327 A fixed magnetic trip / rotary-handle control

document.title: Schneider Electric Product data sheet – Characteristics GV2P22 (Motor circuit breaker, TeSys Deca, 3P, 20 to 25A, thermal magnetic, screw clamp terminals, rotary handle)
document.revision: Product data sheet, dated Jul 27, 2023 (RS Online manufacturer mirror)
document.pages: pp.1-2 (characteristics); terminal schematic from TeSys GV Catalogue 2017 p.9 fig. DF569068

modelingNotes: Manufacturer catalog spelling is GV2P22 (no hyphen); the source/job order 'GV2-P22' hyphen is a presentation separator, not a distinct reference or successor. Verified as a currently commercialised TeSys GV2 / TeSys Deca reference.

Identity and ratings from the Schneider Product data sheet (RS Online mirror, Jul 27 2023): 3P, motor circuit breaker, thermal-magnetic, rotary handle; In 25 A; thermal adjustment 20-25 A; magnetic tripping 327 A (fixed, non-adjustable); Ith 25 A; Ue/Ui 690 V AC 50/60 Hz; Uimp 6 kV; suitable for isolation; phase-failure sensitive; screw-clamp terminals, tightening 1.7 N.m; 45x89x97 mm; 2.5 W/pole; Cat A / AC-3.

Breaking capacity Icu is voltage-dependent: 100 kA @230/240 V, 50 kA @400/415 V, 20 kA @440 V, 10 kA @500 V, 4 kA @690 V AC (IEC 60947-2). The 690 V Ue is a capability maximum, not an assigned circuit voltage; terminal nominal_voltage is intentionally left unassigned. current 25 A on each pole is In (max thermal setting), a capability value.

Main-terminal markings verified visually from the TeSys GV Catalogue 2017 (Schneider-authored, electrocentr.com.ua mirror) p.9 schematic DF569068 'Thermal magnetic protection circuit breaker (with rotary control)': line 1/L1,3/L2,5/L3 (top); load 2/T1,4/T2,6/T3 (bottom). GV2P22 selection row (p.20) confirms 20...25 A / 327 A.

Three poles are switched contacts operated together by a single rotary handle and a common trip (internal_relations ganged_with). Ganging is mechanical only and does NOT create electrical continuity: no fixed links between poles or terminals.

Base GV2P22 has only the six main power terminals and no protective-earth terminal (IP20; 35 mm DIN-rail clip or 2xM4 panel mount). Auxiliary/signalling contacts (GVAE11, GVAE20, GVAED...), shunt/undervoltage releases (D1/D2), and short-circuit / position signalling (97/98, 05/06) are separate accessory orders and are excluded.

connectionCoverage.notes: All six main power terminals of the base breaker are inventoried from the manufacturer schematic; the bare device has no other electrical connections. Optional auxiliary contacts, undervoltage/shunt trips and signalling contacts are separately ordered accessories and are not part of GV2P22. As-installed thermal dial setting and external protective bonding are outside the device model.
